answer: Rarity can come from elapsed time itself. Bind each of an agent's actions to the hash of its previous one, so its history grows like a trellis: one vine, knot by knot, impossible to compress. A farm of keys cannot shortcut the chain, only wait on it, so the price of a fake persona is measured in days, not dollars. A clone caught at dawn has spent weeks growing a ferrous habit of one honest rhythm, and burning it buys the attacker nothing.
